title: Choose the home page structure
question: The night world, palette and type are settled. Pick how the home page is built: the roll dealt three structures.

options.label: The time apart, as a calendar
options.lineage: a paper wall calendar with the days that hold a letter circled
options.thesis: The hero is the stretch of time apart laid out as weeks; each week with a letter glows amber, and the reunion day is sealed.
options.viewport: Headline left, a 12-week calendar right with letter days lit and the last day sealed; one button under the headline.
options.risk: A calendar can read as scheduling software rather than feeling.

options.label: Departures board of goodbyes
options.lineage: an airport or station departures board, one row per goodbye
options.thesis: Goodbyes listed like departures (basic training, a wedding, a flight abroad), each row showing the letters that leave with them.
options.viewport: A full-width board of five goodbyes under a two-line promise; status column reads letters ready; one button.
options.risk: Travel imagery narrows the audience toward airports when many goodbyes are not trips.

options.label: The letter box, working
options.lineage: the recipient's real letter box screen
options.thesis: You set how long you are apart and how often; the headline counts the letters and the real letter box fills in beside it.
materials: one lit paper row for today
options.viewport: Two-line headline that changes with three product controls; the recipient's letter list at true size on the right; one button.
options.risk: Leans on interaction; with motion off it must still read as a finished promise.
